Bundles [MPTUNNEL 0.6.6](https://github.com/mnihyc/mptunnel/releases/tag/v0.6.6) with improvements to TCP startup and CPU efficiency, UDP response recovery under loss, reliable-recovery computation, and QUIC replacement connections.

MPP wire version remains 16. Use a MPTUNNEL 0.6.6 server to receive all fixes; 0.6.0–0.6.5 servers remain wire-compatible. Servers using 0.5.x require a coordinated app/server upgrade. Existing profiles, application IDs, and the signing identity are preserved.

The embedded engine still has known performance limitations with many paths carrying small flows, some QUIC recovery stalls, and carrier-count-dependent throughput. See the MPTUNNEL release notes for scope and tradeoffs.

Downloads include signed F-Droid APKs for `arm64-v8a`, `x86_64`, and a universal APK containing both. `SHA256SUMS` verifies downloads; `build-provenance.json` identifies the app source, exact MPTUNNEL release, native-library archive digests, and APKs.
